label: Kimi Code Access
description: A Moonshot AI login, for the KimiCode nodes' `access`: a pay-as-you-go Moonshot API key. One access for however many KimiCode nodes; each node names the model. A Kimi Code subscription is not offered here: its terms keep it to personal interactive use, and forbid non-interactive automation. On your machine, leave `access` out to use your own `kimi login`.

steps: Sign in at platform.moonshot.ai and create a key under API keys.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account, pay as you go.
Set the node's `model` to a Moonshot model id, such as `kimi-k2-turbo-preview`.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the KimiCode nodes' `access` input.
